applications.name: Identity Data Manager
applications.description: Resolves people and associates source entities, assets and episodes with person records.
applications.connectionRole: Consumes governed entity data and submits allocations; owns person matching and local asset cache.

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Map source identities and episode attributes into IDM person resolution
sourceConfiguration.detail: Mapping rules, identifiers and profile configuration

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Populate IDM's local asset cache for candidate matching
sourceConfiguration.detail: EAM entity type, source, eligibility and paging contract

applications.name: Entity Allocation Manager
applications.description: Governs source entities and attributes, and manages their allocations to consuming systems.
applications.connectionRole: Provides source-governed assets and attributes and target allocation services to other applications.

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Register source entities and preserve source/type identity
sourceConfiguration.detail: Configured source, entity type, class and source identifier

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Acquire entities from configured source systems
sourceConfiguration.detail: Source-specific mapping and profiling; examples include directory and web-table sources

applications.name: Hierarchy Data Manager
applications.description: Maintains hierarchies and node structures, including mappings to ODM organisational nodes.
applications.connectionRole: Defines hierarchy nodes and relates them to governed organisational identities.

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Build or refresh governed hierarchy structures
sourceConfiguration.detail: Structure definitions, node identifiers and mapping rules

applications.name: KPI
applications.description: Provides performance measurement, analytic views and geographic intelligence.
applications.connectionRole: Publishes performance measures and geographical intelligence for consumption by viewers and the suite hub.

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Map values, measures, periods and geography

applications.name: Organisational Data Manager
applications.description: Provides organisational nodes and contextual structures used by the wider suite.
applications.nature: Organisational data and node identity authority
applications.connectionRole: Provides organisational node context used in other applications.

sourceConfiguration.purpose: Resolve source organisational structure into ODM node identity
sourceConfiguration.detail: Specific supported adapters and endpoints not yet verified

applications.name: OneVision
applications.description: Planned user-facing hub presenting outputs from the OneVision suite.
applications.connectionRole: Will present outputs from the other suite applications rather than own their underlying data.

applications.name: OneVision.UI
applications.description: Reusable governed UI design system applied across application interfaces, not a data integration provider.
applications.connectionRole: Provides shared patterns and controls as a design/development dependency, not a runtime data connection.

capabilities.name: Governed entity catalogue
capabilities.summary: Register and retrieve canonical source entities and attributes, preserving source identity and lineage.

capabilities.name: Entity allocation lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Associate known entities with consumer targets, including effective dates, allocation state and multiple-target support according to class rules.

capabilities.name: Bulk allocations
capabilities.summary: Submit multiple allocations efficiently in a single bulk operation.

capabilities.name: Person identity and matching
capabilities.summary: Resolve and match source information to canonical people with confidence and ambiguity handling.

capabilities.name: Episode association
capabilities.summary: Associate episodes and source assets with resolved person records.

capabilities.name: Hierarchy management
capabilities.summary: Build and maintain hierarchical structures, including templated and snapshot-based views.

capabilities.name: Performance and geographic insight
capabilities.summary: Present governed KPI measures, values and geographical views.

capabilities.name: Unified suite presentation
capabilities.summary: Planned presentation of governed outputs from constituent suite applications.

capabilities.name: Reusable interface patterns
capabilities.summary: Common visual and interaction patterns used by suite applications.

capabilities.name: Asset catalogue retrieval
capabilities.summary: Expose governed source assets and identifying information to authorised consumers for local reference and matching.

capabilities.name: Asset cache synchronisation
capabilities.summary: Maintain a local, referenceable cache of EAM assets for identity matching, including the source entity identity.

capabilities.name: Asset-to-person matching
capabilities.summary: Evaluate cached EAM assets against IDM people using governed matching rules, confidence and ambiguity checks.

capabilities.name: Bulk allocation submission
capabilities.summary: Prepare and submit eligible matched asset-to-person associations to the EAM bulk allocation capability.

capabilities.name: Organisational node reference
capabilities.summary: Provide the organisational node identity and structural context needed by consuming applications.

workflows.name: IDM / EAM asset allocation
workflows.summary: The cross-application capability sequence through which EAM assets become IDM match candidates and matched assets are allocated back through EAM.

connection.note: Catalogue retrieval uses entity query; allocatable discovery can scope eligible items. Which endpoint IDM cache currently invokes must be verified against its implementation.
IDM local cache ingestion is an application capability; no externally exposed IDM endpoint asserted.
IDM matching rules run within IDM; no HTTP API endpoint asserted.
IDM invokes EAM bulk allocation. Invocation is recorded here; EAM owns the endpoint.
EAM receives the same bulk request—this is not a second HTTP call.

workflows.name: HDM organisational allocation lookup
workflows.summary: HDM uses EAM's allocation lifecycle capability to identify organisational-node assignments; hierarchy inheritance is resolved by HDM.

connection.note: HDM manages and interprets hierarchy nodes.
The precise EAM lookup endpoint for HDM has not yet been verified.

workflows.name: HDM organisational identity reference
workflows.summary: HDM relates hierarchy nodes to ODM organisational identity; the transport contract has not been verified.

connection.note: Conceptual organisational identity reference; endpoint not verified.
HDM uses the organisational reference when representing hierarchy nodes.
